feature: Overview accuracy PR 6: the claim tap-through, a "Based on" line of card names under each claim that cites cards
note: Needs a server with ANALYSIS_TAB_ENABLED=true, OVERVIEW_V2_ENABLED=true and the stub model, signed in as the account the decks belong to. Seed with `PROBE_USER_ID=<clerk id> pnpm probe:method-notice --seed` (local-dev only), which prints MN_CONTRACT_8, a deck whose shown overview is contract 8 with its evidence stored; remove with `--unseed`. The stub cites evidence on tips and Key cards only. check:shared does not apply: the one component, the full-overview sheet, is the surface at both widths. The second row presses a listed card to prove it opens the existing card details.
